title: 260425_104822_FR_Steam_train_arriving_at_St-Valery by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Steam train arriving at Saint-valery-sur-Somme station. I made this recording during ‘’La fête de la vapeur’’ (The Steam Festival), held in La Baie de Somme (north of France), at the end of April 2026. Here, one can hear the atmosphere in Saint-Valery-sur-Somme train station, while one of the steam trains exhibited and used during the festival was arriving. First, one can hear the stationmaster’s whistle, the warning bell, then the train arriving slowly, as well as the crowd’s reaction. At the end of the file, as the train has stopped, people start to walk on the gravel platform in order to go
